defensiveAbilities.name: Causational Moments
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature would trigger Paradox 17's Reactive Strike, but it has no reactions remaining

Effect Paradox 17 Steps or Strikes prior to resolving the triggering action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reject Reality
defensiveAbilities.description: 100 feet. When a creature in the aura observes Paradox 17 for the first time each day, it must attempt a DC 42 Will Saving Throw save or Performance check. On a failure, reality rejects the creature for as long as it can observe Paradox 17. The affected creature becomes hidden from all other creatures (except Paradox 17) as though invisible itself.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bridge of Perception
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Another creature is observing Paradox 17 or has triggered interdict definition in the last hour

Effect Paradox 17 teleports to any location that both Paradox 17 and the required creature can observe across any distance, even to another galaxy or plane.

offensiveAbilities.name: Disregard Reality
offensiveAbilities.description: Paradox 17 can move through all creatures, objects, and structures as though they were incorporeal.

offensiveAbilities.name: Interdict Definition
offensiveAbilities.description: Paradox 17 automatically and instantly learns and can observe the exact location of any creature on any plane that succeeds at a Recall Knowledge check to learn any information about Paradox 17 or any creature who communicates information about Paradox 17 in any way. The ability to observe the creature and its surroundings, wherever the creature goes, lasts 1 hour.

offensiveAbilities.name: Natural Invisibility
offensiveAbilities.description: Paradox 17 is naturally invisible. It becomes visible only when using a hostile action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Waking Light
offensiveAbilities.description:
Paradox 17 burns away the fabric of reality with intense sunlight. If no creatures are observing Paradox 17, the light fills a 60ft Type:cone. If any creature is observing Paradox 17, the area is a 60ft Type:line. Creatures and unattended objects in the area turn temporarily translucent. Creatures in the area take 24d6 Fire Damage damage and must attempt a DC 45 Reflex Saving Throw save. Paradox 17 can't use Waking Light again for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage becomes Doomed 1.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes Doomed 2.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and becomes Doomed 3.

lv5spells.name: Truespeech (constant)
lv5spells.description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

lv9spells.name: Wave of Warning
lv9spells.targets: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures
lv9spells.description:
You deter enemies with a wave of hostile intent. The target takes 7d8 nonlethal mental damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Frightened 2.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.

lv9spells.name: Slice Reality
lv9spells.description:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

lv9spells.name: Implosion
lv9spells.description:
You crush the target by causing it to collapse in on itself, dealing 75 damage. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, you must choose a new target to be subject to the same effect; the same creature can never be targeted more than once with a single casting of this spell. You also can't affect more than one creature per turn with implosion. You can't target a creature that's incorporeal, gaseous, or liquid, or otherwise lacking a solid form.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.

lv10spells.name: Event Horizon
lv10spells.description:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is Slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and Slowed 2 for 1 minute.

lv10spells.name: Indestructibility
lv10spells.duration: until the start of your next turn
lv10spells.description: You sever yourself from cause and effect. For the duration of the spell, you are immune to any effect or damage that would harm you, excluding effects caused by artifacts, deific power, and similarly powerful sources. You can selectively allow yourself to be affected by anything you're willing to have affect you.
